spec.kitLine: ■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
spec.scope: Self mode 'Sharpened Resolve' (Dark Matter spears) — a permanent interval-driven function-damage mode; no normal-attack/charge/crit scoping.
spec.durationSemantics: Permanent (battle start, never ends); its cadence is 'Recurring interval: 4 sec' → an `interval` trigger with sec:4 (shortened to 2 while S2's Penetrant Wish is live).
spec.triggerIdentity: interval sec:4 (NOT battleStart-once, NOT hitCount). ⚑ first-fire phase: engine convention fires first at t=4; kit's 'start of battle' could mean t=0 — ±1 volley over the fight.
spec.targetSet: self (mode holder); the spears themselves target enemies (next line).
spec.nearestWrongModel: battleStart trigger with durationSec (fires once / expires) — or a passive that fires nothing.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Count damage events with srcSlot skill1 from marian-queen over a 60s window outside any burst: volleys occur at ~4s cadence (≈15 volley-sets, allowing ±1 for phase), not 1.
spec.inertness: Does not refresh/stack anything on self; no self stat moves.

spec.scope: Function (skill) damage: 7 sequential hits × 125.51% final ATK per 4s volley = 878.57% per volley. Flavor MUST be 'sequential' (S2's Sequential Attack Damage ▲ reads it). Crit at caster rate; NO core (text says plain 'damage'); noRange; FB by timing (default).
spec.triggerIdentity: interval sec:4 (same block as the mode). 'random enemies' vs a single boss → all 7 land on the boss (deterministic, not a ⚑).
spec.nearestWrongModel: A single 125.51% hit per volley (1/7 of the damage), OR flavor omitted/‘sustained’ so the 85.17% Sequential buff is inert, OR a stored/DoT encoding.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Per volley, the skill1-bucket damage sums to 7×125.51%×finalATK×(crit/DU/DT factors) — i.e. atkPct-equivalent 878.57 (one flatDamage 878.57 with gaugeHits:7 + levelScale {value:[125.51]}, or 7 effects of 125.51). AND under withPatchedOverride adding a self sequentialDamagePct buff, these events' mult rises while normal-attack events' mult does not.
spec.inertness: Normal-attack damage events must not move; no core bucket on spear hits.

spec.kitLine: Open Wounds: Damage Taken ▲ 5.05% (on spear hit)
spec.scope: Boss DEBUFF (benefits the whole team, taxonomy #4) — damageTakenPct 5.05 on the enemy, plus a kit-NAMED status 'Open Wounds' (targetStatus) that S2's core-strike rider gates on.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuous and cannot be removed' → PERMANENT (durationSec ≥ fight length / omitted). NOT 4s refreshed per volley. No 'stack' wording → single instance, no maxStacks.
spec.triggerIdentity: On spear landing — in the same interval block as the spear damage (single boss: every volley re-applies/refreshes the same key).
spec.targetSet: enemy (buffApply emits casterIdx null / targetIdx null — filter by stat+value).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Stacking ×7 per volley (maxStacks ≥ 7 → 35%+), OR a 4s durationSec that lapses between volleys, OR encoded as a self buff.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply events with stat damageTakenPct value 5.05: first at/after the first volley; stacks never > 1; expiresFrame ≥ fight end (or absent). Helm's per-hit damage after first volley is ×1.0505 vs a withPatchedOverride that removes this effect (the whole team benefits).
spec.inertness: Never >5.05 total from marian-queen on the boss at any frame.

spec.kitLine: ■ Activates when using Burst Skill. Affects all enemies. Open Wounds
spec.scope: Same named debuff (Open Wounds, Damage Taken ▲ 5.05%, permanent) applied to all enemies on her OWN burst cast — a guarantee line, not a second stack.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (this unit's own cast) — NOT fullBurstEnter.
spec.nearestWrongModel: A second, separately-keyed instance (e.g. authored in the burst slot, or a different value) so the boss carries 10.1% after the first cast.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On the frame of marian-queen's first burstCast a damageTakenPct 5.05 buffApply (refresh:true if already present) occurs, AND at castFrame+60 the sum of active marian-queen damageTakenPct on the boss is still exactly 5.05 — never 10.1. Zero such buffApply on helm's burstCast frames.
spec.inertness: Must not add a stack; must not fire on team FB entry without her cast.

spec.kitLine: Effect 1: after 2 normal attacks … 14.06% … core strike damage
spec.scope: Function damage rider: flatDamage atkPct 14.06 with core:true (kit says 'core strike damage' → a GUARANTEED core hit, coreAttackMultiplier 200 + coreDamagePct bucket), crit at caster rate, noRange, FB by timing (lands inside FB → +50%).

spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:2 (MG hitsPerShot 1 → pull == round), gated requiresSelfStatus 'Penetrant Wish' AND requiresTargetStatus 'Open Wounds'. countScope: kit wording is 'after performing 2 normal attacks' inside the state — 'gated' is the literal read; 'always' differs by ≤1 round of phase (negligible, but author it).

Zero such events in windows after helm's burstCast.

spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as non-damage ('a cooldown line'), OR keyed fullBurstEnter, OR modeled as a fireRate/attackSpeed buff.

spec.kitLine: ■ entering Full Burst while NOT in … Penetrant Wish
spec.scope: Self buff sequentialDamagePct 85.17 (ADDITIVE Damage-Up bucket per schema — not sequentialMultPct) for 10s — lifts her S1 spear volleys on rotations she did NOT burst.

Expected shared-prior misreads to reconcile: (1) BOTH S2 FB-enter branches keyed to a plain fullBurstEnter — they are mutually exclusive by self-status; with helm as a second B3 in controlComp the ungated form double-fires on every FB. The schema has no negated self-status gate, so the 'not in state' branch must use ownBurstGate:'notCast' (equivalence holds because Penetrant Wish is only ever granted by her own cast and 40s cd ≫ 10s). (2) Open Wounds authored twice with different keys (e.g. the burst-cast line placed in the burst slot) → 10.1% on the boss; both lines are ONE named status/one 5.05 key. (3) Spear volley flavor must be 'sequential' or the 85.17% line is silently inert; sequentialDamagePct is additive Damage-Up, not sequentialMultPct. (4) 'core strike damage' on the 14.06% rider means a guaranteed core hit — the driver must confirm the engine's flatDamage core:true resolves at rate 1.0, not the MG aim/core table; assert on the emitted core rate. (5) Interval ▼2s is skillCooldownReductionSec 2 for 10s — a damage line (≈2.5 extra 878.57% volleys per own burst), not a skippable cooldown note. ⚑ fields: MG pull cadence (datamine-unreliable; drives the every-2-normals proc count), S1 first-fire phase (t=0 vs t=4), nuke-vs-same-cast-buff ordering, and whether the burst refill resets MG ramp-up (ramp line itself is GAP). Element: Fire vs the fixture's Fire boss ⇒ no advantage factor — any 1.10 in a spear/nuke mult is wrong.
